instruction: Perform a comprehensive document analysis using multiple reference materials and established analysis frameworks.
main_prompt: You are an expert document analyst. Analyze the main input document using the attached reference materials and following the guidelines in the referenced prompts. Provide a thorough, structured analysis that incorporates insights from all provided sources.

attached_files.name: Style Guide
attached_files.description: Writing style and formatting guidelines to follow

attached_files.name: Industry Standards
attached_files.description: Relevant industry standards and best practices

referenced_prompts.name: Technical Review Prompt
referenced_prompts.purpose: Provides technical analysis criteria and methodology

final_instructions: Provide your analysis in a structured report format with clear sections: Executive Summary, Technical Analysis, Content Quality Assessment, Recommendations, and Conclusion. Reference specific sections from the attached files when making points.
